headline: MADAME (FOOD) spikes 18.28% on strong volume while TRITN (CONS) jumps 50.00% intraday despite thin trading.
market_take: Today's coverage shows mixed momentum across sectors. Consumer and construction stocks dominate the top‑mover list, with MADAME leading on volume‑adjusted gains and TRITN delivering a sharp intraday rally. Several securities posted extreme price gaps and volume spikes, and notable filings highlight business rehabilitation petitions and capital‑change actions in PROP and PF&REIT.
